# Rosebud AI Lab

> > Rosebud AI Lab is an AI-powered game creation platform that enables anyone to build 2D/3D browser games, visual novels, and interactive stories through vibe coding and no-code tools.

The platform specializes in AI game generation, character chat experiences, and romance/anime game creation. Founded by Patrick Moumiet and team, Rosebud AI uses technologies like Three.js to enable rapid game prototyping through natural language descriptions, making game development accessible to beginners and marketers alike.

## Key Topics

- Vibe Coding
- AI Game Generation
- No-Code Game Development
- Visual Novel Creation
- AI Character Chat
- Three.js Game Development
- Romance Game Design
- Anime Character AI
- Game Prototyping
- Interactive Story Games
- Browser-Based Games
- RPG Design
- Dating Sim Creation
- AI-Driven NPCs

## Core Platform & Tools

- [Free AI Game Generator – Create Games Online | Rosebud AI](https://lab.rosebud.ai/ai-game-generator): No-code AI game generator for creating 2D/3D browser games from descriptions
- [Vibe Code Games](https://lab.rosebud.ai/vibe-code-games): AI-powered vibe coding platform for creating 2D/3D browser games instantly

## Game Categories & Collections

- [Romance Games - Free Love Story Games Online | Rosebud AI](https://lab.rosebud.ai/game-category/romance-games): Collection of free romance games and dating sims playable in browser
- [Play RPGs and AI Simulation Games - Rosebud AI](https://lab.rosebud.ai/game-category/rpg-and-simulation-ai-games): Collection of RPG and simulation games featuring Star Wars and Isekai themes
- [Chat with Naruto AI Characters - Talk to Naruto, Sasuke & More | Rosebud AI](https://lab.rosebud.ai/game-category/chat-naruto-ai-characters): Interactive AI conversations with Naruto characters like Sasuke and Kakashi
- [Chat with Solo Leveling AI Characters - Talk to Sung Jinwoo & More | Rosebud AI](https://lab.rosebud.ai/game-category/chat-solo-leveling-ai-characters): Interactive AI chat with Solo Leveling characters like Sung Jinwoo
